en: Right. Sorry to disturb ya.
You know where Baba is? The kid in our cell?
Oh, him. Nope, dunno.
Okay...
Heh, is there something wrong? I hope so. I'm bored out of my mind.
Nothin' happened. Sorry to bug ya.
Oooh, hehe, something sure went down. I can't wait to find out...
Say, listen.
Did ya see that commotion earlier?
No... I didn't see anything. No stabbing, no nothing.
I got the hell out of there as soon as I heard the screams. I only looked back once, and... *gulp* saw them carrying away some guy. He was bleeding.
Did ya see Baba-chan? The guy holdin' the chisel?
Uh, I mean we all did! You saw him, too! He just stood there, shaking.
But ya didn't see the actual stabbin', right?
That's what I said! Didn't see nothing, I swear!
Can ya tell me somethin'?
Oh, yeah. That's some crazy shit he pulled.
You saw him stab the guy?
Nah, didn't actually see it. But come on, it's obvious he did it.
I mean, he even had motivation. Wasn't Kugihara picking on him?
Just yesterday I saw Kugihara's gang taking him to the storeroom. Didn't look consensual, if you know what I mean.
That damn bastard...
Hell yeah. Kugihara's a total psycho.
I heard he pretty much drove one of his own cellmates to attempt suicide.
That's fucked up shit. I bet Baba was getting attacked by Kugihara and his goons, and just struck back.
Nah, Baba-chan ain't the kind of man who would do that, even if it was deserved.
And if no one saw the actual stabbin', maybe Baba-chan didn't do it.
The victim said it was him, though, didn't he?
Those creeps can't be trusted. We're gonna prove Baba's innocent.
Well, see ya around.
Uh, hey.
Good luck. Proving his innocence.
Finished everything you wanted to do, Kiryu-san?
There's something I want to take care of first. Wait for me here.
Understood. Try not to be too long, though.
Let's hear what you have to say.
Okay. Let's head inside, then.
Yamaura-san! I got Airi Yuki-san's autograph!

You did!? Way to go, girl! Horie-kun's really gonna love it.
Was it hard to get?

Not really. I got to meet Airi-san, and I think I learned a
lot from the experience!

Well, good for you! I'll bring this to Horie-kun next time
I visit, so don't worry about a thing. You just take it
easy.
Okay. Thank you!
Oh, hey, Haruka.
I'm just glad you're okay.

Did ya finish everything ya needed to do? It's gonna be
nothin' but practice from here on out.

So if ya have any last-minute stuff ya need to take care of,
now's the time to do it. If not, whaddya say? Ready to practice?
I'm sorry. Could I have just a little bit more time?

All right. But it might be dangerous out there. Be careful,
ya hear?

(Am I really ready to start practice? I think I might have
some other things to take care of first.)
Yes, I'm ready to practice!
All right, great. Let's get started!
Yamaura-san, how is Horie-san doing?
Oh! About that. Think ya could help me think of something?
Something for what?
Some kind of present to bring Horie-kun while he's in the hospital.
Oh, all right. Hmm, let me think...

Knowing him, he'd probably say he didn't want us fussing
over him when we should be focusing on something more important.

In fact, your successful debut would probably be the best
present of all, don't you think?

But we gotta get him somethin', ya know? Can't just go visit
empty-handed.

And I'm sure he wouldn't want another fruit basket. It would
just be in the way.

Exactly! I tell ya, I've really been scratching my head over
it, but I can't come up with anything...

Well, let's see... What does he like? Is there anything he's
interested in?
I hardly know anything about his personal life.
Isn't that awful? My own manager and I don't even know him!
Well, I know one thing Horie-kun is interested in...
Idols! He's a big fan, ya know.
Really!? Idols!?

Don't tell me you're surprised. He's an idol manager, isn't
he?

Well, yes, but I thought people just did that sort of thing
because it was their job.

Yeah, sure, some people are like that. But not Horie-kun! He
was a real idol otaku when he was younger.

Come to think of it, I guess he did mention he likes idols.
But I never imagined it was such a big thing with him!

He used to be a groupie for some underground singers.
Started giving them advice, and, before he knew it, he was
arranging gigs!

He said it was so much fun seeing the singers he loved get
popular that he finally just decided to get into the
business officially.

Once he got into the industry, he said it was time to grow
up and put aside his groupie ways.
Hehe. He's very dedicated, isn't he?

But even now, he still goes to see his favorites' concerts
on his days off.

Apparently, he went to see an idol named Airi Yuki perform
recently, and somebody from another agency caught him tons
of souvenirs.
Hehe! I bet he'll never live that one down. It sure sounds like he loves idols!

Hey, here's a thought! I bet Horie-kun'd love to get Airi
Yuki's autograph, don't you think?
Ah, that's a great idea!

That settles it, then! Haruka, I want ya to go see Airi Yuki
and get her autograph for Horie-kun!

You mean right now!? But isn't it kind of awkward to try
seeing her without making an appointment first or anything?

But that's the kind of thing Horie-kun did for you every
single day to get you work. It's what we in the business
call "walk-in sales."
Well, when you put it that way... All right, I'll do it!

Good girl! Oh, hold on. At least lemme help ya find out
where she's at right now.

Hello. This is Misa Yamaura from Dyna Chair. Could you tell
me where Airi Yuki-san is scheduled to perform today?
Ah, I see. Thank you very much. All right. Goodbye, now!
What did you find out?

This will work out great! She's gonna be performing at
Castle Records, they said. Go get that autograph!

(My goodness. Yamaura-san can be a little pushy sometimes...
But this is for Horie-san, and he's always doing so much for
me, so surely I can do this for him!)
Yamaura-san, you called me earlier about an audition, right?
Oh, yeah! Want me to fill you in?

You said it's an audition for Watami and Watamin-chi's
poster girl?

That's right. This one'll be a little different from a
regular audition, however. It's gonna be a joint audition
this time around.
A joint audition?

Watami and Watamin-chi are both looking for a new poster
girl, and they got the idea to hold their auditions together.

The audition will be conducted by the presidents of
Watami and Watamin-chi themselves.

And they're each hoping to find the perfect poster girl. In
other words, there are two spots open.

Oh, okay! But I've never heard of two companies holding an
audition together. They must get along really well.

Well, Watami and Watamin-chi are both part of the Watami
Group, after all. But I wouldn't go so far as to say they
"get along."
Really? Why's that?

I hear the two presidents have a really strong sense of
rivalry with each other. They're both out to prove they're
better than the other.

That's why they're doing a joint audition, apparently. The
audition coordinator told me sparks have been flying
nonstop.
Oh, okay...

They're both fiendishly determined to find the best poster
girl.
Hmm. I don't know if that's a good thing or a bad thing...

What're ya talkin' about? This is a big opportunity for us!
These are two huge companies we're talking about
here⑬national chains.

You get hired as one of their poster girls, and your face
will be plastered all over the country.
Oh, wow. That's true.

Might wanna do a little studyin' before you go to that
audition. Don't wanna embarrass yourself.
Right. Good point.

First is Watami. They're all about good old-fashioned home
cooking.

They call themselves a "casual restaurant," somewhere
between a pub and a family-style place. It's the oldest
pillar of the Watami Group.

The prices are reasonable and the food is pretty yummy. And
with their twentieth anniversary, all the restaurants
underwent a huge remodel.
Hmm. I see.

And then there's Watamin-chi, the charcoal grill restaurant.
They're about ten years younger than Watami.

They focus on charcoal-grilled foods and stews. Their food
is well-priced and yummy, too!

Whenever I pass by one, there's always this amazing smell
coming from the place. I mean, that's totally unfair, right?
It should be outlawed!

Their menu items have really fun names, too, like "Spaceship
from Planet Orange" and "Red, Red, Fuzzy Cow Pow."
Hehe, you're right. Those are pretty funny.

Anyway, that's it for the quick rundown. Head on over to the
audition as soon as you're ready.
Really? You mean, right now?

Yes, right now! If you don't hurry up and get over there,
those positions are gonna get filled!
So whaddya say, Haruka? You ready?
All right. I'll go right away, then!
Hehe, attagirl! Knock 'em dead out there!

I'm afraid I'm not ready to go just yet. I have to prepare
a little first...

All right. But come back and lemme know as soon as you're
ready.
Yamaura-san, about that audition...

I know this isn't the best time, but if ya don't hurry up
get over there, the positions are gonna get filled! Any
chance ya can go right now?

Haruka, if ya don't hurry up and get over to that audition,
the positions are gonna get filled! You ready to go?

I'm afraid I'm not ready to go just yet. I want to prepare a
little first...
There you are, Haruka. Wanna hear more about that audition?

It's an audition to be a poster girl for Watami and
Watamin-chi, right?
Oh, Haruka! Think ya could help me think of something?
%s-san. You good and ready?
%s-san. Finished getting ready?
Finished getting ready?
No, I still have things to take care of.
All right. Let me know when you're done.
No, still gotta tie up of a few loose ends.
Nope, still got some stuff I need to do.
All right. Say the word when you're done.
Okay, it's almost time.
Good, it's almost time.
Change characters?
%s. You finished getting ready?
Can I have a bit more time?
Sure. Let me know when you're good.
All right. It's almost time.
Oh, Haruka. Here for your lesson?
Yes, please!

On second thought, you're lookin' pretty lifeless at the
moment. Can't risk havin' ya get hurt.
I understand. Thanks, anyway.
Okay, let's get started. Tell me what you wanna work on.
(Which song should I choose?)
(How difficult of a lesson do I want?)
(I think I'll try an easy "So Much More!" lesson.)
Okay. I can do this!
(I think I'll try "So Much More!")
(I think I'll try a hard "So Much More!" lesson.)
I'm sorry, I guess I'm not ready for this right now.

Hey, there isn't much time before the finals. Do whatever ya
need to do quick and get back here.

How do you think I'm doing so far? Do you think I can win
the Princess League?
Well, with your abilities as they stand right now...

Frankly, I don't think you stand a chance. You gotta sharpen
your skills a whole lot more, or you'll just be wastin' your
time up on stage.
I see. Thank you. I'll keep practicing!

...It's pretty dicey, if ya ask me. You're gonna be going up
against T-Set. You'd hafta somehow pull off some kinda
miracle to beat them.
I see... Thank you.

I think ya got a real shot. Of course, it really all depends
on how you do when you're up on stage.
Right. Thank you!

Ya know what? I think you can! Just make sure you don't make
any serious goofs, and I think you're in.
Right! Thank you very much!

Well, you've heard it about a billion times, so I think ya
know, but the music for round one, "So Much More!," is a
cutesy pop song.

T-Set's specialty is hard dance numbers, so this song's sure
to take 'em a little outta their element.

So I think ya got a real shot at the first round. But you
better bust your butt practicin', if you wanna win.
No, I just dropped in to say hello.

Hey, there ain't much time before the finals. Do whatever ya
need to do quick and get back here.
Ready to go home?

Hello, Haruka-chan. All done for the day? Park-san asked me
to see ya home safe.

Just lemme know when you're ready. Unless you're ready to go
now, that is?
I'm sorry. Could you wait a little longer?
You got it. Just lemme know when you're ready to go home.
Okay, I'm ready.
All right. Off we go, then.
Haruka-chan, are you ready to go?
I'm sorry. I'm not quite ready.
No problem. I'll be waitin' right here.
I'm all set.
Okay, off we go, then.

You did it, Haruka! That was some great dancing! All we
gotta do now is keep our fingers crossed for round two!
